parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The region. Valid values:

- **CN**: the Chinese mainland

- **OverSeas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)

- **AP1**: Asia Pacific Region 1

- **AP2**: Asia Pacific Region 2

- **AP3**: Asia Pacific Region 3

- **NA**: North America

- **SA**: South America

- **EU**: Europe

- **MEAA**: Middle East and Africa

- **all**: all regions

The default value is **CN**.

parameters.name: DataProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol of the data to query. Valid values:

- **quic**: QUIC

- **https**: HTTPS

- **http**: HTTP

- **all**: all protocols

The default value is **all**.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name that you want to query. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 domain names in each call.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the merged data of all accelerated domain names is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time. The time range between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 31 days.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description:
The type of data to query. Valid values:

- **bps**: bandwidth

- **traf**: traffic

- **acc**: number of requests

> You cannot query the number of requests by **Area**.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the data to query, in seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see the **Usage notes** section.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The minimum time granularity is 5 minutes.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of requests. Valid values:

- **static**: static

- **dynamic**: dynamic

- **all**: all

The default value is **all**.
